description: This file defines an 'EditorPane' component responsible for editing notes within a LightningJS-based application. It manages note state, user interactions like editing and deleting notes, and rendering the UI for the note editing interface.

methods.name: autosave
methods.description: Saves the current note state by calling NoteService.updateNote and updates the lastSavedAt timestamp.

methods.name: focusTitle
methods.description: Sets the cursor to indicate editing the note's title.

methods.name: focusContent
methods.description: Sets the cursor to indicate editing the note's content.

methods.name: $onDelete
methods.description: Triggers the display of a confirmation dialog to delete the current note.

methods.name: $confirmDelete
methods.description: Handles the user's response to the delete confirmation dialog, performing deletion if confirmed.
